subject.title: feat(macos): Quick Chat power features — voice dictation, paste-to-app, model/reasoning control

question: Should Quick Chat expose a session-persistent model picker alongside a per-message reasoning picker, and should all three power features land together in this macOS surface?
rationale: This is a new user-facing macOS workflow whose model choice modifies target-session state, so implementation correctness alone cannot establish the intended long-term product contract.

options.title: Sponsor the complete Quick Chat feature set
options.body: Accept dictation, paste-to-app, and session model/per-message reasoning controls after native proof verifies their permission and persisted-state behavior.

options.title: Land only non-persistent controls
options.body: Narrow the PR to dictation and paste-to-app, deferring the session model picker until its persistent-session contract is explicitly designed.

options.title: Defer the feature bundle
options.body: Pause this PR until macOS Quick Chat scope and model-selection ownership are decided separately.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the complete Quick Chat feature set
recommendation.body: Accept dictation, paste-to-app, and session model/per-message reasoning controls after native proof verifies their permission and persisted-state behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned author has the clearest available connection to this proposed macOS Quick Chat direction, though broader ownership history remains incomplete.
